description: This file defines a class `PayGradeConfigurator` which implements the `MenuConfigurator` interface, configuring menu behavior for the pay grades section within the OrangeHRM system. It uses traits and external entities to customize the screen related to pay grade management.

classes.name: PayGradeConfigurator
classes.description: Class responsible for configuring the menu for pay grade views in the HRM system, overriding the screen to 'viewPayGrades'.

methods.name: configure
methods.description: Sets the current module and screen to 'viewPayGrades' using a helper method, and returns null.
